stem.text: The decomposition of $\text{SO}_3\text{(g)}$ is a dynamic equilibrium.
What happens when the pressure of the system is increased?

A.text: The rate of reaction will decrease and the position of the equilibrium will move to the left.

B.text: The rate of reaction will decrease and the position of the equilibrium will move to the right.

C.text: The rate of reaction will increase and the position of the equilibrium will move to the left.

D.text: The rate of reaction will increase and the position of the equilibrium will move to the right.
